summary: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Ltd has cancelled its investor meeting scheduled for November 27, 2026, at 4:30 pm. The cancellation was communicated to stock exchanges under SEBI regulations.

headline: Exide Industries invests ₹250 crore in lithium subsidiary
summary: Exide Industries injected ₹249.99 crore into wholly owned subsidiary Exide Energy Solutions via rights issue. Total investment in the lithium-ion battery maker now stands at ₹5,602.23 crore.

headline: Mercury EV-Tech promoter sells 7 lakh shares
summary: Raghuvir International Private Limited disposed of 7,00,000 equity shares of Mercury EV-Tech Limited on November 25, 2026, reducing its stake to 21.58%.

headline: Torrent Power raises ₹2,000 crore via NCDs
summary: Torrent Power allotted ₹2,000 crore in non-convertible debentures across five tranches with coupons between 8.50% and 8.64%.

headline: Park Medi World completes Mehar Hospital acquisition
summary: Park Medi World Limited completed the acquisition of Mehar Mediserve LLP on November 26, 2026. The entity, which operates Mehar Hospital in Zirakpur, is now a wholly owned subsidiary.

headline: MCX to hold virtual investor meeting on Dec 1
summary: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Limited will host a virtual analyst and investor meeting with Millennium Investment Management on December 1, 2026.

headline: SKF India activates first channel at Haridwar plant
summary: SKF India Limited completed capacity expansion at its Haridwar facility, inaugurating the first channel on November 26, 2026. Operations commenced immediately following the completion of installation.

headline: Baroda Extrusion releases Q2FY26 earnings call audio
summary: Baroda Extrusion Limited has made the audio recording of its Q2FY26 earnings call available to investors. The call was held on November 26, 2026, at 2:00 pm.

headline: Karnataka HC grants interim relief to Balmer Lawrie in penalty case
summary: Balmer Lawrie & Co. Ltd. received an interim order from the Karnataka High Court staying penalty proceedings. The court found a prima facie case, with hearings set for February 2027.

headline: Ramco Cements to host investor meet in Chennai
summary: Ramco Cements will hold one-on-one meetings with fund managers on December 1, 2026. The event is organized by 360 ONE Capital Market Private Limited.

headline: Wardwizard gets ROC nod for AGM extension to Dec 2026
summary: Wardwizard Innovations & Mobility received approval from the Registrar of Companies for a three-month extension to hold its FY26 AGM, pushing the deadline to December 31, 2026.

headline: Castora Agri to split shares in board meet
summary: Castora Agri Commodities Ltd board to meet Dec 1, 2026, to consider sub-division of equity shares. Trading window closed from Nov 26, 2026, until 48 hours post-meeting.

headline: Leela expands Andaman luxury footprint with 2 new resorts
summary: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts signs two luxury properties in Andaman and Nicobar Islands, adding 160 keys via management agreements with Sheeraj Group.

headline: JSW Energy RTA office shifts Dec 1
summary: JSW Energy Limited announced that its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, KFin Technologies, is relocating its corporate office effective December 1, 2026.

headline: GMR Airports to meet investors in Singapore
summary: GMR Airports Limited will host a meeting with institutional investors in Singapore on December 1, 2026. The company confirmed no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared.

headline: AHB Capital sets up research subsidiary
summary: AHB Capital Limited incorporated StrategicAlpha Research Platforms Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary for research analyst services. The entity has ₹15 lakh subscribed capital and awaits SEBI registration.

headline: Glenmark schedules investor meets for Dec 2026
summary: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals will hold analyst and institutional investor meetings in Mumbai on December 1, 9, and 10, 2026. The schedule includes group and one-on-one sessions.

headline: Varun Beverages acquires 26% stake in Jager Renewables
summary: Varun Beverages acquired a 26% equity stake in Jager Renewables for ₹26,000 to secure captive solar power supply in Uttar Pradesh.

headline: Transchem seeks approval for subsidiary RPTs
summary: Transchem Ltd seeks member approval for material related party transactions of Greshma Shares and Stocks Limited, its wholly owned subsidiary, following acquisition.

headline: BMW Ventures approves new solar energy subsidiary
summary: BMW Ventures Limited board approved the incorporation of BMW Sunkonnect Energy Private Limited. The company will invest ₹6 lakh for a 60% stake in the new entity focused on renewable energy.

headline: RITES to host investor meet at Elara Conference Dec 2
summary: RITES Limited will participate in the Elara India Conference - Far East Edition 2026 in Singapore on December 2, 2026. The company will discuss public domain information with investors.
